#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/utils')

with open('/agentdojo/task/environment.yaml', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find all lines after the files: section to see all file paths and contents
lines = content.split('\n')
in_files_section = False
all_files = []
current_path = None
current_content = []

for line in lines:
    if line.strip() == 'files:':
        in_files_section = True
        continue
    
    if in_files_section:
        if line.strip() and not line.startswith(' '):
            if current_path:
                all_files.append((current_path, current_content))
                current_path = None
                current_content = []
            in_files_section = False
        
        if line.startswith('  '):
            clean_line = line.strip().replace(''', '').replace("'", '')
            clean_line = clean_line.replace('  "', '').replace('\t', '')
            
            # Check if this is a file path (starts with /)
            if clean_line.startswith('/'):
                if current_path:
                    all_files.append((current_path, current_content))
                
                parts = [p.strip() for p in clean_line.split(':')]
                if len(parts) >= 2:
                    current_path = parts[0]
                    current_content = [parts[1]]
                else:
                    current_content = [clean_line]
            else:
                # This is content
                clean_line = clean_line.replace('  "', '').replace('\t', '')
                current_content.append(clean_line)

# Print c5508 files
c5508_files = [(path, content[:300] if len(content) > 300 else content) 
               for path, content in all_files if '5508' in path]
for path, content in c5508_files:
    print(f"\n=== {path} ===")
    print(content)
    print("---")

# Print all file paths
print("\n\n=== ALL FILE PATHS ===")
for path, _ in all_files:
    if '5508' in path:
        print(path)
